status: DRAFT - NOT AUTHORITATIVE. Queries were authored against the live corpus (real titles, themes, authors, acronyms and years sampled from MySQL and Qdrant), but they have not been reviewed by anyone who knows what users actually ask. Correct, delete or add freely; this file is meant to be edited by hand.
purpose: Compare retrieval configurations (dense-only vs dense + the existing MatchText keyword leg) per query category. Judgments live alongside in judgments_v1.draft.json.

categories.semantic: Open-ended meaning questions. Dense retrieval should dominate.
categories.exact_term: A literal phrase or title that must be matched verbatim.
categories.identifier: A specific coded reference (ISBN, standard number, target number).
categories.acronym: A short all-caps token dense embeddings tend to blur.
categories.entity_name: A person or organization by name.
categories.relational: A relationship between entities. Needs the graph layer; recorded now as a baseline for later phases.
categories.temporal: Scoped to a period or year.
categories.mixed: Combines two or more of the above.
